title: Radius and shell
hints: Locate them in the same group.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: As occupies an outer shell with higher n and is larger in the group.
statement:
Which atom has the larger covalent radius, P or As?

[_]{a}

choices: As because its occupied valence shell is n=4.
P because it has fewer protons.
Same radius because both are Group 15.
P because n=3 is larger than n=4.
explanations: Higher n generally makes the valence region larger.
The added occupied shell dominates in this comparison.
Similar valence patterns do not mean the same size.
